title: Gloria Steinem, groundbreaking feminist campaigner, dies aged 92
summary_full: Prolific author campaigned against domestic violence, female genital mutilation,  pornography and the Vietnam and Gulf warsGloria Steinem, the American feminist and journalist whose activism helped push through greater rights for women around the world has died, aged 92.Steinem “passed away peacefully at her home in New York City, surrounded by some of the many who loved her”, a statement shared to her Instagram page said.
